title: Data import
subtitle: Import historical data from external sources into DriveChronik.

tessie.title: Tessie
tessie.description: Import historical driving and charging data from a Tessie raw data export.
tessie.details: Select the four CSV files from the Tessie raw data export. DriveChronik checks the files before the import starts. Existing TeslaMate periods are protected.
tessie.ready: All four Tessie files were uploaded and checked successfully.

errors.filesMissing: Please select all four Tessie files.
errors.serverFilesMissing: The uploaded files are incomplete on the server.
errors.invalidJob: The import job could not be created.
errors.unknown: An unknown error occurred during the Tessie import.
